# Skills Index

This directory contains repository-specific Copilot skills.

## Available skills

- `gh-address-comments` - address open PR review comments
- `gh-fix-ci` - inspect failing CI checks and propose fixes
- `omniflow-azure-blob-ops` - Azure Blob/Azurite operator commands
- `omniflow-data-operator` - dataset pipeline operation runbook
- `omniflow-execplan` - per-task execution plan management
- `omniflow-github-operator` - safe git and GitHub operator flow
- `omniflow-llm-orchestration` - deterministic backend-first LLM orchestration
- `omniflow-step-endcap` - strict endcap response formatting

## Maintenance rule

When changing skill trigger phrases, keep `.github/instructions/trigger-governance.instructions.md` aligned with any trigger registry artifacts in this repository.
